title: private-deployment-orion-weekly-sync-2026-07-27
content:
Weekly sync notes for ORION private deployment (VPC + on-prem) - 2026-07-27

Attendees: Ava Chen (owner), Diego Morales (network lead), Priya Kumar (SRE), Samir Patel (customer eng), Ben Lowe (On-prem infra, remote) - Ben dialed in late
Absentees: N/A

Agenda / quick context:
- Status update across network/VPC setup, on-prem installation, KMS integration, and rollout plan.
- Blockers that are causing delays and owners.
- Next milestones & dates.
- Action items and owners for the coming week.

High level status:
- VPC peering and routing: In progress, blocked on customer's firewall rules (security team) and a missing NAT gateway decision. Diego driving.
- On-prem image install (air-gapped): Image tested in lab; validation scripts failing on host preparation step (missing kernel modules on customer hardware). Samir coordinating a field visit next week.
- KMS/HSM integration: Initial key provisioning successful in test environment; HSM vendor requires firmware update on customer side (ticket opened). Priya tracking.
- Observability/metrics: Basic metrics streaming set up to customer Influx endpoint; long-term retention plan TBD.

Milestones (owner, target) - updated 2026-07-27:
- Network: customer firewall rules approved (Diego) - target 2026-07-30 (was 2026-07-28; pushed due to security review)
- VPC peering complete + validation (Diego) - target 2026-08-02
- On-prem host preflight and kernel modules fixed (Samir + Ben) - target 2026-08-03
- Air-gapped image install + smoke tests (Samir) - target 2026-08-06
- KMS firmware update + integration re-test (Priya) - target 2026-08-04
- Canary traffic cutover (rollout plan ready) (Ava) - target 2026-08-10

Blockers / notes / context:
1) Firewall rules (customer security) - Blocker - owner: Diego
   - Customer flagged port ranges for control plane; their security team is requesting leapfrog justification and packet captures. They want a formal architecture diagram + minimal port list. I uploaded the trimmed diagram to Confluence (link above).
   - Suggested workaround: set up a temporary jump-host in customer VPC to validate connectivity while full approval is pending. Customer ops hesitant.

2) Missing kernel modules on a subset of target nodes - Blocker - owner: Samir + Ben
   - During host preflight, image validation script failed on 3/12 hosts (Dell R750 clones). Error: missing 'vfio-pci' module and incorrect iommu config. Customer OEM might need BIOS tweak.
   - Plan: Samir to remote into two hosts Wed 7/29 to try modprobe & persist config; Ben to schedule on-site for the remaining host on 8/01.

3) HSM firmware mismatch - Medium - owner: Priya
   - Vendor flagged that their HSM requires firmware 3.2.x for the PKCS#11 module we use. Customer's firmware is 2.9.x. Vendor provided upgrade instructions but requires maintenance window. Customer scheduled a window 8/03-8/04; we should sync testing after.

4) Observability retention and export policy - Low - owner: Ava
   - Need to confirm retention limits and whether customer accepts sending metrics offsite (they currently want retention on-prem only). Follow-up with product/infra to see if we can offer short-term remote buffer + eventual purge.

Decisions made this week:
- We will not proceed with automated kernel module injection across customer hosts without explicit ops approval. Manual remediation first, then propose automation.
- Use of temporary jump-host approved by Diego as contingency; must be hardened and approved by customer security.

Action items (owner - due)
- Diego: finalize trimmed architecture diagram + minimal port list; send to customer security by EOD 2026-07-27. (DONE)
- Diego: follow up with customer security for formal approval and explore jump-host hardening checklist. (2026-07-30)
- Samir: attempt remote fixes (modprobe/persist) on two failing hosts; capture logs and escalate to Ben if on-site required. (2026-07-29)
- Ben: schedule on-site visit for remaining host; coordinate with customer ops for access and BIOS changes. (2026-08-01)
- Priya: coordinate HSM firmware upgrade window with vendor and customer; prepare re-test checklist. (2026-08-03)
- Ava: finalize canary rollout plan doc and add rollback criteria; share with customer for review. (2026-08-02)
- Ava: confirm metrics retention options with infra/product and propose short-term buffer approach. (2026-08-03)
- Samir + Priya: run a combined integration test after kernel fix + HSM firmware update; report results. (2026-08-05)

Notes to self / follow-ups I want to track:
- Check ORION-1345 (observability export edge-case) and confirm whether metrics pipeline can be toggled per-namespace. If not, we should add this as a product feature request.
- Ensure PR #88 in orion-deploy includes the extra volume mount for HSM sockets; I left a comment requesting windows of downtime in the PR description.
- Reminder: collect customer-signed change approval for on-site BIOS changes (compliance requirement).

Risks / mitigation:
- Risk: firmware/BIOS delays push canary out beyond SOW (low probability but medium impact). Mitigation: prioritize two-node canary in cloud region while on-prem completes.
- Risk: customer refuses jump-host due to policy - Mitigation: propose time-limited access with strong auditing and iptables rules; escalate to account exec if needed.

Prep for next sync (2026-08-03):
- Diego to confirm firewall approval status (good to have approval note in Jira).
- Samir to report host remediation progress with logs attached.
- Priya to confirm HSM vendor readiness and post-upgrade test plan.
- Ava to send canary plan and rollback criteria for customer review 48 hours before cutover.

Misc / miscellaneous:
- Customer asked for a brief slide (1-2 slides) summarizing risk & rollback for execs. Action: Ava to draft and share by 2026-07-29.
- Customer mentioned interest in longer-term dedicated metrics retention (paid add-on). Add to commercial follow-up with CS.

End notes: This doc is a working scratchpad - will clean up and push key updates to Confluence + attach logs to JIRA ticket JIRA-ORION-1234. Next sync: 2026-08-03 10:00 PT (tentative).

Unresolved questions:
- Can product support per-namespace retention toggles for on-prem installs in next quarter? (Product input needed)
- If kernel module issues occur on >50% hosts, do we pause automation? SOP to be defined.
_notes: informal scratchpad; used to prepare agenda and capture action items after meeting
